test_title: PYST 45: SSC GD Constable - GA & GK (Held On - 20 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Constitutions limit the power of government in many ways. The most common way of limiting the power of government is to specify certain _______ that all of us possess as citizens and which no government can ever be allowed to violate.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fundamental Rights**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fundamental Rights** are the basic human rights enshrined in the Constitution of India which are guaranteed to all citizens.
 
• These rights are considered essential for the holistic development of individuals and the preservation of human dignity.
 
• The Constitution of India provides six fundamental rights to its citizens:
 
 
• Right to Equality
 
• Right to Freedom
 
• Right Against Exploitation
 
• Right to Freedom of Religion
 
• Cultural and Educational Rights
 
• Right to Constitutional Remedies
 
 
 
• Fundamental Rights act as limitations on the powers of the government, ensuring that the state does not encroach upon the basic liberties of individuals.
 
• These rights are justiciable, meaning that any violation can be challenged in a court of law.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Directive Principles of State Policy** are guidelines for the framing of laws by the government. These are non-justiciable in nature, meaning they are not enforceable by any court.
 
• **Economic Duties** and **Fundamental Duties** refer to the responsibilities of citizens towards the state and society, but they do not limit the powers of the government.
 
• The **Fundamental Rights** are enshrined in Part III of the Constitution, from Articles 12 to 35.
 
• The protection of these rights is essential for the functioning of a democratic society and the assurance of justice, equality, and liberty to all citizens.
